name: Tvoja Volja
source:
Raised on hardship, you were promised nothing but struggle. Now, a divine presence offers power and pleasure – at a price that could break you. In this world, even sweetness demands sacrifice.

[From [url=https://chichka.itch.io/yourwill]Itch.io[/url]]
